015-1. THE STRIKE SQUAD ENTERS THE DUNGEON FIRST AND DEFEATS ALL THE BEASTS, EXCEPT FOR THE BOSS.
015-2. AFTER THAT, THE HAULING TEAM GATHERS UP THE CORPSES OF THE BEASTS.
015-3. THEN FINALLY, THE MINING TEAMMINES THE CRYSTALS.
015-4. IN ORDER TO MAXIMIZE PROFITS, NONE OF THESE STEPS CAN BE SKIPPED.

015-6. THE CORPSES OF HIGH-RANKING BEASTS ARE ALSO VALLABLE BECAUSE THEY CAN BE USED FOR A WIDE VARIETY OF PURPOSES.

017-5. THAT RARELY EVER HAPPENS, BUT...

018-5. I GUESS IGNORANCE IS BLISS.

019-4. BUT I'M ALSO IMPRESSED BY THE OTHER MEMBERS OF THE A-RANK RAID TEAM AS WELL. DESPITE THEIR LOWER RANKS,THEY EACH SERVE ANIMPORTANT ROLE.
019-5. THAT'S PROBABLY WHY THEY'RE ABLE TO SAFELY CARRY OUT RAIDS.
019-6. TOGETHER,THEY MAKE A STRONG TEAM. IT'S NOT JUST BECAUSE THEY'RE MADE UP OF STRONG HUNTERS,THEIR SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE COME FROMYEARS OF EXPERIENCE.
